name: T & J Wire Forming Inc
old_description: Flat Forms, Wire Forms, Light Stampings & Fixtures, Powder Coating, Tooling & Dies
about:
T & J Wire Forming Inc. has operated from Addison, Illinois since its founding in 1991. The locally owned and operated shop began as a specialist in custom wire forming and has grown into a full-service metal fabrication partner.

The company produces wire forms, flat forms, light stampings, fixtures, and tooling and dies, working with both ferrous and non-ferrous materials. Its shop runs four-slide stamping presses for high-volume component production, CNC equipment for precision forming, and an in-house tool and die department that builds the dies used for cutting and swedging. Powder coating and plate finishing round out the service offering.

Its customer base consists mainly of other manufacturers and industrial firms across multiple sectors that need custom-formed wire and stamped components. The company emphasizes a personal-touch approach, tailoring production runs to client-specific requirements.

T & J Wire Forming highlights its ISO 9001:2015 certification, combined decades of manufacturing expertise, and a commitment to timely delivery of essential raw materials as the factors that distinguish its service.
